historical_evidence_policy: Historical protocol payload and protocol_hash preserved. MUST NOT contribute TRAIN, CALIBRATION, VALIDATION or OOS rows to MR-20260926-1; MUST NOT fit, calibrate, select, lock or promote any MR candidate.

protocol.baseline: paired same-decision midpoint AND ask; fixed incumbent family probability also compared

calibration.method: fixed intercept grid on separate CALIBRATION only
calibration.report: 10 equal-width ECE bins; per-row residual is not calibration quality

protocol.champion: retain existing active research champion; if none, report null; fixed family references are not promoted champions

dataset_schema.admission: native V2 ledgers; reconstruct raw observations, features and authoritative labels; reject synthetic/imported rows

protocol.economic_gate: positive net PnL AND reward after evidenced costs; qualified fees, slippage, reconciliation, approval, allocation and risk controls; no self-attestation

cross_market_consistency_v1.formula: clip midpoint to interval [higher_strike_mid,lower_strike_mid] only if interval coherent
cross_market_consistency_v1.why: Separate books can temporarily disagree on nested strike probabilities.
cross_market_consistency_v1.why_unpriced: Multi-leg execution, depth and spread may erase apparent arbitrage.

microstructure_dislocation_v1.formula: clip(mid + 0.5 * (prior_mid - mid)); prior same-ticker quote age 30..90 seconds
microstructure_dislocation_v1.why: Temporary inventory pressure may overshoot a recent quote midpoint.
microstructure_dislocation_v1.why_unpriced: Thin depth and maker inventory constraints may delay reversion; this is unproven.

time_structure_v1.formula: logistic(0.9*logit(mid)) in fixed 240..300 second time-to-close cohort
time_structure_v1.why: Near settlement, thin books may express excessive confidence.
time_structure_v1.why_unpriced: Short horizon execution costs may exceed calibration gains.

underlying_kalshi_lag_v1.why: Asynchronous reference and Kalshi updates may leave temporarily stale probabilities.
underlying_kalshi_lag_v1.why_unpriced: Feed latency and scarce liquidity may prevent immediate correction; fast makers may eliminate it.

volatility_regime_v1.formula: 0.9*mid+0.05 if RMS(last 30 closed 1m log returns)>=0.001, else mid
volatility_regime_v1.why: A volatility jump can make probabilities overconfident before makers widen distributions.
volatility_regime_v1.why_unpriced: Regime estimation is noisy and inventory costly; no systematic mispricing assumed.

protocol.features: fixed family probability only as logit input; original family formulas/features unchanged; no new feature search
protocol.independence: UTC day blocks, not five family copies; disjoint underlying events; independence assumption must pass external review before promotion
protocol.missing: no imputation; all qualified family decisions in each fixed window require labels by cutoff; missing family data => DATA_QUALIFICATION_FAILED
protocol.oos: 7 full UTC days beginning next midnight strictly after actual immutable challenger lock; predictions must be appended before close; evaluate once at end+1h; no reconstructed post-outcome forecasts

optimization.objective: minimum mean Brier on TRAIN only

protocol.promotion: manual external independent review after validation, future OOS, baseline and positive economics; no auto-promotion or self-approval

reward.consistency: positive net-PnL day fraction; descriptive until independent-period review; at least 7 complete days for economic admission
reward.control_violation: permanent disqualification, never compensated by profits
reward.eligibility: authoritatively settled native accepted qualified shadow cohort only; any open accepted position blocks aggregate; rejected or synthetic rows earn no reward; n<2 leaves variance/reward unavailable
reward.slippage: deduct once in net PnL; additional explicit risk surcharge in reward

protocol.scope: KXBTC15M; first valid observed quote per event in 240..300 seconds before close
protocol.selection: one challenger per family; validation and OOS Brier/logloss strictly beat midpoint and ask; Brier beats fixed family; paired day sign-flip one-sided p<=0.01 for each baseline and family; report all five families
protocol.target: authoritative finalized YES payout, integer 0 or 1
